{{Quote|He was a colonel in the infantry. Special Forces. Every mission he gave me, I ran circles around all his fancy officers.|Major Anri|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]]'s '''old master''' was a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] in the [[Imperial Special Forces (Sith Empire)|Special Forces]] of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. Though the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was nominally his slave, he allowed her to run actual combat missions, in which Anri consistently outperformed the regular officers, making them furious.<ref name="TOR" /> In the aftermath of [[Darth Malgus]]'s attempted coup, the Sith Empire reluctantly began to integrate non-humans into its military.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Alien Initiatives}}</ref> With the new rules in place, Anri ceased being treated as a slave, while her skills instantly earned her a commision into an officer position of her own.<ref name="TOR" />
